title: Merino Wool Crewneck Sweater
description_html:
The only sweater you'll reach for every day.

Made from 100% extra-fine 18.5-micron merino wool, this crewneck sits at the intersection of performance and style. Merino regulates body temperature naturally — warm when it's cold, breathable when it's not — making it the ideal layer from morning commute to evening dinner.

Why merino over cotton or synthetic blends? Merino fibres bend rather than scratch, so there's zero itch against bare skin. It also resists odour naturally, meaning you can wear it multiple days between washes without it showing.

  • 100% extra-fine merino (18.5 microns) — softer than cashmere blends at a fraction of the price
  • Relaxed crewneck silhouette — works tucked or untucked, layered or solo
  • Reinforced shoulder seams — retains shape wash after wash
  • Colours: Charcoal, Ivory, Forest Green, Slate Blue
  • Machine washable on wool cycle — no dry-cleaning required

Fits true to size. Order your usual size for a relaxed fit, or size down for a closer silhouette.
image_alt: Merino wool crewneck sweater in charcoal grey worn by model

title: Classic Oxford Dress Shirt
description_html:
The shirt that works harder than you do.

Cut from a 120s two-ply Oxford weave cotton, this shirt transitions from boardroom to bar without missing a beat. The semi-spread collar holds its shape without stays, the back box pleat adds movement, and the slightly tapered body means it looks intentional whether tucked or untucked.

What makes a great Oxford shirt: Thread count alone doesn't determine quality — weave structure does. Two-ply Oxford weave creates a fabric that breathes, holds its colour through dozens of washes, and develops character over time rather than pilling.

  • 100% two-ply cotton Oxford weave — 120s thread count, woven in Portugal
  • Semi-spread collar with hidden collar-stand construction (no stays needed)
  • Single-button adjustable cuffs — roll to 3/4 length without falling
  • Box pleat at back yoke for full arm movement
  • Mother-of-pearl buttons — resistant to cracking in machine wash
  • Available in White, Classic Blue, Pale Pink

Care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low, remove immediately — it will need minimal ironing.
image_alt: Classic white Oxford dress shirt on model, collar open

title: High-Waist Compression Leggings
description_html:
From HIIT to brunch — leggings that hold up to both.

Built from a 4-way stretch nylon-spandex fabric with 30 UPF sun protection, these high-waist leggings are engineered for performance and styled to wear beyond the gym. The 8cm waistband stays flat and fold-free through any movement, and the deep side pockets actually fit a full-size phone.

  • 79% nylon, 21% spandex — 4-way stretch moves with you without sagging
  • High-rise 8cm waistband: non-rolling, supportive without compression discomfort
  • Deep side pockets (hold iPhone 15 Pro Max flat, no bulge)
  • Squat-proof fabric: light-coloured styles include built-in liner
  • UPF 30 protection — safe for outdoor running and yoga
  • Flat-lock seams: no chafing on long runs or cycling
  • Available in Black, Navy, Sage Green, Dusty Rose

Fits true to size. If between sizes, size up for comfort during high-impact workouts.
image_alt: High-waist black compression leggings worn by model in yoga pose

title: Premium Down Puffer Jacket
description_html:
Warmth without the bulk — engineered for real winters.

Filled with 750-fill-power Responsible Down Standard (RDS) certified goose down, this jacket delivers serious warmth at a fraction of the weight of traditional winter coats. The DWR (Durable Water Repellent) outer shell sheds light rain and snow, while the baffled construction prevents cold spots at the seams.

Fill power matters more than fill weight: 750-fill-power down is lofter, lighter, and compresses smaller than budget down fills. This jacket packs into its own chest pocket — carry-on size, 580g total weight.

  • 750-fill-power RDS-certified goose down — traceable, humane sourcing
  • DWR-treated 20D ripstop nylon shell — sheds rain, won't wet-out
  • Baffled construction: no cold spots at seam joins
  • YKK zippers throughout — smooth, snag-free for years
  • Packable: stuffs into chest zip pocket, 580g total
  • Rated to -10°C / 14°F as a standalone layer
  • Colours: Midnight Black, Olive, Burgundy, Frost Grey
image_alt: Premium down puffer jacket in midnight black worn by model outdoors

title: Slim Stretch Denim Jeans
description_html:
Denim that actually moves with you.

These slim-fit jeans use a 3% elastane weft yarn woven through Cone Denim's American-milled selvedge fabric. The result is a jean that holds a clean, tailored silhouette without the stiffness of raw denim — they stretch enough for full-range squats and cycling, snap back without sagging.

Selvedge vs. standard denim: Selvedge is woven on narrow shuttle looms, creating a tighter, denser weave that fades more naturally and holds its shape longer. Most denim today is woven on high-speed machines — selvedge takes 6× longer per yard and shows over time.

  • 97% Cone Denim selvedge cotton, 3% elastane — USA milled
  • Slim cut through thigh and leg, not skinny — full range of motion
  • Mid-rise 10.5" rise — sits at natural waist, no gap at back
  • 5-pocket construction with reinforced coin pocket rivets
  • Copper rivets and tack buttons — last the lifetime of the denim
  • Available in Indigo (raw), Washed Blue, Faded Black

Sizes are waist in inches. Inseam is 32" — hemming service available at checkout.
image_alt: Slim stretch denim jeans in indigo blue worn by model

title: Floral Wrap Midi Dress
description_html:
One dress. Every occasion.

The wrap silhouette is the most universally flattering cut in fashion — it cinches at the waist, drapes over the hip, and adjusts to your exact body by tying at the front. This midi length version in a digital-print floral on 100% LENZING™ EcoVero™ viscose is the piece that travels from garden party to work dinner without a second outfit.

  • 100% LENZING™ EcoVero™ viscose — certified sustainable wood-fibre fabric, flows like silk
  • Adjustable wrap front: ties at natural waist for a bespoke fit on every body
  • Midi length (ankle to mid-calf depending on height) — formal enough for events, casual enough for lunch
  • V-neckline flatters all necklines
  • Two hidden hip pockets — holds phone and keys
  • Digital floral print: fade-resistant reactive dye, stays vibrant after 50+ washes

Styling note: Pairs with block-heel sandals and a linen blazer for the office, or white sneakers and a denim jacket for weekends.
image_alt: Floral wrap midi dress in bloom print worn by model outdoors

title: Low-Top Leather Sneakers
description_html:
The sneaker that goes with everything — and gets better with age.

Constructed on a hand-lasted last over a full-grain vegetable-tanned leather upper, these low-tops were designed for the long game. Vegetable tanning uses oak bark rather than chromium — slower and more expensive, but produces leather that breathes, develops a patina, and lasts 10+ years with basic care.

  • Full-grain vegetable-tanned leather upper — no corrected-grain or bonded leather shortcuts
  • Cupsole construction: vulcanised rubber outsole bonded to a cushioned EVA midsole
  • Leather-lined interior: breathes and moulds to your foot shape over time
  • Unisex sizing (EU sizing chart at base of page)
  • Colourways: White/White, White/Gum, Black/Black
  • Ages into a natural patina — each pair develops uniquely

Care: Condition with leather balm every 2–3 months. Use a suede brush on creased toes to restore texture.
image_alt: White leather low-top sneakers on clean white surface

title: Cashmere Ribbed Beanie
description_html:
The hat you'll fight over in winter.

Knit from Grade A Inner Mongolian cashmere in a 2×2 rib pattern, this beanie is the best cold-weather accessory you'll ever own. Cashmere is 8× warmer than sheep's wool by weight — which is why this beanie weighs 68g and outperforms most full-length wool scarves.

  • 100% Grade A 2-ply cashmere — sourced from Inner Mongolia's Alashan region
  • 2×2 rib pattern: stretches to fit all head sizes, springs back to shape
  • Slight slouch construction — sits back on the head rather than over the ears if preferred
  • Colours: Black, Camel, Ivory, Burgundy, Sage Green
  • Unisex — one size fits most
  • Hand wash cold, dry flat — will last 10+ years with proper care

Our most-gifted item — includes a ribbon box and gift card option at checkout.
image_alt: Cashmere ribbed beanie in camel worn by model, slight slouch

Lightweight 100% linen shorts with an elastic-and-drawstring waistband and two deep side pockets. The natural linen weave gets softer with every wash and keeps you cooler than cotton or synthetic blends in summer heat.

  • 100% stonewashed linen — pre-washed for softness

A versatile ribbed crop tank in a 95/5 cotton-elastane blend that holds its shape through workouts and wear. The wide-strap silhouette works solo as a workout top or layered under an oversized blazer for going out.

description_html:
A classic double-breasted trench in a water-resistant 65/35 cotton-polyester gabardine. The removable belt cinches at the waist, and the storm flap and gun patch are functional rather than decorative. Fits over a suit jacket or heavy knitwear.

  • 65% cotton, 35% polyester gabardine — water-resistant finish
  • Removable belt with D-ring buckle
  • Functional epaulettes and storm flap
  • Fits over a suit jacket

title: Waxed Canvas Tote Bag
description_html:
Heavy-duty 18oz waxed canvas tote with reinforced cotton webbing handles and a raw-edge interior. The wax finish repels light rain and develops a natural weathered patina over years of use. Deep enough for a 15" laptop, gym kit, or a week of groceries.

  • 18oz waxed canvas — water-resistant, gets better with age
  • Reinforced 1" cotton webbing handles — tested to 30kg load
  • Interior zip pocket for keys and phone
  • Riveted handle joins — no stitching to blow out
  • Available in Natural, Black, Olive

title: Printed Silk Square Scarf
description_html:
A 90×90cm square scarf in 12mm satin-weave silk with a hand-rolled hem. Wear as a headscarf, neck scarf, tied to a bag, or as a bandeau top. The geometric print is produced using water-based reactive inks that won't crack or fade.

  • 100% 12mm silk — lightweight and breathable
  • Hand-rolled hem — the mark of quality silk craftsmanship
  • 90×90cm square — versatile size for head, neck, or wrist
  • Reactive-ink print: colour-fast through 50+ hand washes
